items.title: createGiftCardsStep
items.description:
This step creates gift cards. If no code is provided for
a gift card, a unique code is automatically generated. The step supports rollback
by deleting the created gift cards.

items.title: deleteGiftCardsStep
items.description:
This step deletes gift cards by their IDs. The step supports rollback by
restoring the deleted gift cards.

items.title: retrieveGiftCardsBalanceStep
items.description:
This step retrieves the balance of gift cards from their associated store credit accounts.
Returns a map of gift card codes to their account stats.

items.title: updateGiftCardsStep
items.description:
This step updates gift cards. It stores the previous state of the gift cards
before the update to enable rollback.
